title: The Mini's revolutionary technical choices
author: codex-blog-rewrite
excerpt: The Mini became revolutionary by combining transverse engine, front-wheel drive, corner wheels and a cabin-led layout.
content:
The Mini was not revolutionary because it was small. It became important because it combined several technical choices in a very short body and made them work as one system.

Practical final checks

The model's birth is covered in why the Mini was created. Motorsport follows in why the Mini worked in rallying.

Sources

  • BMW Group PressClub, 1959 - 2019. Sixty Years of MINI
  • National Motor Museum, Austin Mini Seven
  • The Guardian archive, The new Morris Mini-Minor, 1959
